business_summary: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited is a Chinese underground construction equipment manufacturer listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR market, controlled within the China Railway Construction group. Operating revenue for 2025 was CNY 10,045,298,702.64, down 0.01 percent. Main-business revenue of CNY 9,972,458,200 splits by product into tunnel boring machines 57.05 percent (including intelligent and super-large shield machines, shaft and inclined-shaft borers and hard-rock TBM, plus equipment leasing), rail transit equipment 24.43 percent (high-speed turnouts, brake shoes, fasteners) and special professional equipment 18.52 percent (tunnel construction robots, mining equipment, high-end agricultural machinery). By region, mainland China is 70.50 percent and overseas 29.50 percent, the latter up 109.62 percent year on year across more than 50 countries. Net profit attributable to shareholders CNY 1,483,028,394.33 (-1.65 percent), operating cash flow CNY 1,100,910,637.77 (-46.15 percent). Source: the issuer's 2025 annual report.

exposure_summary.narrative: One ACTIVE placement on the tibet-mega-dam chain: tunneling-tbm (position 6, heat UNDISCOVERED, bottleneck criticality HIGH), where the company develops and manufactures hard-rock tunnel boring machines for water and hydropower tunnels. The chain's own bottleneck note names CRCHI first among qualified large hard-rock TBM suppliers and 688425.SS is the link's only example ticker. The Medog design diverts the Yarlung Tsangpo through roughly four headrace tunnels of about 20 kilometres each, which is the schedule-critical work this link supplies. The issuer's own 2025 annual report names that project starting construction at about CNY 1.2 trillion of total investment and identifies deep-buried long tunnels as a driver of tunnel-boring-machine demand, but discloses no revenue, order or backlog attributable to it.

issuer_named_occurrence.claim: The market-review section of the issuer's own 2025 annual report states that in 2025 the lower Yarlung Tsangpo River hydropower project formally began construction with total investment of approximately CNY 1.2 trillion, alongside the South-to-North Water Diversion middle-route Yangtze-to-Han supplement and the Beibu Gulf water allocation schemes, and concludes that the spread of deep-buried long-tunnel and alignment-straightening methods will drive demand for tunnel boring machines and drill-and-blast construction equipment. The same report records that the company redirected surplus raised funds into a new water-diversion tunnel boring machine equipment research and application project, and that it was approved as a national railway-industry innovation base for intelligent drill-and-blast equipment for high-altitude complex railway tunnels.
issuer_named_occurrence.why_it_matters: This is the only candidate on the theme whose own audited disclosure names the occurrence the campaign is built on, and it names it as a demand driver for the exact product line that is 57 percent of its revenue. It is market context and a capital-allocation decision, not an order announcement, and it is treated as such.

disclosed_theme_revenue_pct.basis: No Medog- or Yarlung-Tsangpo-attributable revenue, order or backlog figure is disclosed anywhere in the 2025 report. The product-line share above is the closest disclosed proxy and is a different claim.

direct_exposure.basis: The chain's own bottleneck note names CRCHI first among large hard-rock TBM suppliers and 688425.SS is the link's only example ticker, so this is the pure-play expression of tunneling-tbm rather than a diversified proxy for it. The mapped role evidence is a Tunnelling Journal article of 2026-01-15 (INFERRED) recording a CRCHI hard-rock TBM completing a seven-kilometre spiral tunnel in ultra-hard rock; this run adds the issuer's own audited product-line disclosure and its own naming of the occurrence behind it.

capture.basis: The chain scores tunneling-tbm capture 55, lower than the money corner's 65, on 'few qualified large hard-rock TBM suppliers, but the customer is a monopsony SOE; pricing power partial'. The issuer's own numbers say the monopsony half of that is real: the tunnel-boring-machine line earned a 30.37 percent gross margin in 2025 but the margin fell 3.14 points year on year while the line's revenue fell 7.24 percent, and the hard-rock TBM and shaft-borer sub-line fell 12.85 percent with margin down 2.21 points. Pricing is being given back into a customer base that is largely the state railway and hydropower construction system, and the company's own controlling shareholder sits inside that system. The one leg growing is overseas: 294,141.99 of main-business revenue in units of ten thousand yuan, up 109.62 percent, at a 27.10 percent gross margin.
